goal: Retire the standalone quality-guard fork and route retro-burn at the fixed plugin hook, so an unseen file stops blocking on pre-existing violations

notes.diagnosis: Local defect in a fork, structural in that fork's baseline model. The active hook was ~/.claude/quality/quality-guard.mjs, a separate version 1 baseline implementation whose baselineCountsFor returns an empty object for an unseen file, so every rule reads zero before. The source repo already fixed this at 891dd91 with unseenVerdict plus a version 2 baseline that records the scanned file list. Nothing invoked the fixed copy.

steps.title: Generate a version 2 baseline for retro-burn
steps.description: Run the plugin scanner over retro-burn and write .github/quality/quality-baseline.json in version 2 format. The fixed hook returns 0 when that file is missing, so without this the gate is inert rather than fixed.
steps.result: version 2, 218 files, total 4204. Test paths declared: RetroBurn.Core.Tests, Scenario/, gdunit4_testadapter_v5, test/. Hook exits 0 on HelmQueryExpander.cs, the Case 1 file.

steps.title: Remove the standalone hook block from settings.json
steps.description: Delete the PostToolUse entry in ~/.claude/settings.json that runs C:/Users/siriu/.claude/quality/quality-guard.mjs. The plugin now ships its own PostToolUse hook, so both fire until this one goes.
steps.verify_cmd: node -e "const s=require('C:/Users/siriu/.claude/settings.json'); if(JSON.stringify(s).includes('.claude/quality')) process.exit(1); console.log('settings.json parses, no standalone reference')"
steps.result: Removed the whole matcher group (Write|Edit|MultiEdit) holding the single standalone hook. Two PostToolUse groups remain: inject-timestamp and ste-write-guard. No .claude/quality reference survives.

steps.title: Delete the standalone fork
steps.description: Remove ~/.claude/quality/quality-guard.mjs and ~/.claude/quality/project-linter.mjs, then the empty directory. RE-SPECCED after the first attempt returned BLOCKED: ~/.claude/lib/changed-lines.mjs is NOT part of the fork. hooks/ste-write-guard.mjs line 18 imports it, and settings.json still wires that hook into PostToolUse. It stays.
steps.verify_cmd: node -e "const {existsSync}=require('fs'); const gone=['C:/Users/siriu/.claude/quality/quality-guard.mjs','C:/Users/siriu/.claude/quality/project-linter.mjs'].filter(existsSync); if(gone.length){console.error('still present',gone);process.exit(1);} if(!existsSync('C:/Users/siriu/.claude/lib/changed-lines.mjs')){console.error('shared library wrongly deleted');process.exit(1);} console.log('fork removed, shared library intact')"
steps.result: Both quality/ files deleted, directory removed. lib/changed-lines.mjs intact, ste-write-guard.mjs still parses. One leftover flagged: ~/.claude/settings.json.bak (dated 2026-07-29, pre-existing) still names the deleted path. Inert, not deleted, reported to the user.

steps.title: Delete the version 1 baseline in retro-burn
steps.description: Remove C:/Development/Projects/retro-burn/.quality-baseline.json. It is version 1, untracked by git, and nothing reads it after S02. The user approved this.
steps.result: Deleted. Confirmed version 1 with no files array, and untracked by git before deletion. Version 2 baseline intact, hook still exits 0 on HelmQueryExpander.cs.

steps.title: Add the Case 2 and Case 5 regression tests
steps.description: Add two tests to packages/quality-guard/scripts/ that pin the scenarios the bug report named. Case 2: a write that strictly reduces violations in a git-tracked but baseline-unseen file must not block. Case 5: adding a comment to a file with pre-existing over-length lines must not report those lines as new.
steps.result: Case 5 test added on the first pass. Case 2 added by a fixer after the first attempt declined it on a mistaken duplicate argument: 498 lines exceeds the 450-line new-file ceiling, so the test is falsifying. git-tracked-adoption.test.mjs now holds 6 tests. Suite green: 18 + 31 + 51 passing, 0 failing. Production files unmodified.

steps.title: Prove the fix end to end in retro-burn
steps.description: Drive the installed plugin hook with real PostToolUse payloads against retro-burn. A git-tracked but baseline-unseen file carrying pre-existing violations must exit 0. A file the new baseline records must still exit 2 on a genuine regression.
steps.verify_cmd: two hook invocations described in the briefing, expected exit codes 0 then 2
steps.result: Paired proof, both halves reproduced independently by the orchestrator. Proof A: HelmQueryExpander.cs dropped from files[], hook exits 0 and re-adopts 69 violations, total back to 4204. Proof B: check_canon_citations.py kept in files[] with complexity lowered to 0, hook exits 2 and reports 'complexity: 0 before, 6 now'. No loophole. Baseline restored, SHA-256 ab7b287b45 matches pre-work.

steps.title: Fix the stale paths in enforcement.md
steps.description: ~/.claude/enforcement.md documents the baseline as .quality-baseline.json at the repository root, and points the scanner at packages/dod-guard/skills/quality-refactor/. Both are wrong now. The baseline is .github/quality/quality-baseline.json in version 2 format, and the scanner moved to packages/quality-guard/.
steps.verify_cmd: the scanner path quoted in enforcement.md must exist on disk and must accept --test-path
steps.result: Section rewritten: correct baseline path and version 2 format, the inert-when-missing behaviour, the tracked versus untracked split for an unseen file, the corrected scanner path, the baseline generation flags, and the .quality-skip sentinel. 108 lines to 127. Three headings unchanged. Verified pure ASCII, 0 non-ASCII characters.
